subject: Request: 3-month trial top-up + custom discount for MedSight pilot — exec approval
messages:

Subject: MedSight: ask for 3mo top-up + 15% custom discount (pilot retention)

Hi team,

Quick context: MedSight (pilot live since 10/05) is hitting data ingestion limits next week and Procurement is asking for a single packaged concession so they can sign MOU before holidays. Tara and I discussed two asks: a 3-month credit top-up to cover expected overage (~$22k in credits) + a 15% custom discount on the first annual committed tier if they convert within 90 days.

Why: They showed strong usage patterns in our last regen report (attached). The CPO said the discount is a gating item for Procurement + legal wants clean one-off package instead of multi-line redlines.

What I need from you: exec signoff or a clear counter (limits/cap) we can present today. If approved, I will send the MOU + DocuSign link to Tara and loop legal for minimal redline.

Attachments: medsight_trial_usage_report.csv (usage & forecast)

Proposed summary for approval callout:
- 3-month top-up = $22,000 in hosted credits
- 15% one-time discount on first-year committed spend (applied as invoice credit)
- Commitment: 12-month minimum if they convert; otherwise promotional credits only

Thanks,
Ben

--

Subject: Re: MedSight: ask for 3mo top-up + 15% custom discount (pilot retention)

Thanks Ben — good summary. Couple of quick thoughts before we escalate to the exec thread:

- Confirmed that the $22k projected top-up keeps them covered through end of Q1 usage forecasts (reasonable).
- Commercial risk: 15% off first-year ARR is larger than our standard conversion incentive. Can we make that contingent on a 12-month minimum commit and a milestone (SLOs/uptime + data residency terms)?
- Legal will want the discount as a line item in the MOU (credit against first invoice) rather than a long-term change to pricing doc.

If you can add exact renewal ARR numbers (expected committed ARR) I'll escalate to Vivek and include an exec summary slide. I want approval by EOD so we can send the DocuSign link tomorrow.

Also add the procurement contact (procurement@medsight.com) to the thread when you loop them.

-L

Subject: Fwd: MedSight package details + numbers (for exec)

Vivek — forwarding the ask with the numbers Lauren requested. Short summary for review:

- Expected committed ARR on conversion: $420,000/year
- Proposed concession: $22,000 hosted credits (one-time, applied to trial account) + 15% credit on first-year invoice applied after invoice issuance (one-time)
- Condition: 12-month minimum commit and mutual SLO acceptance; credits void if they cancel before commit term
- Business rationale: fast procurement signoff -> enterprise pilot expands to 3 additional product teams in Q2 -> faster expansion runway

Attachments: proposed_mop_terms_redline.pdf, approval_summary_slide.png

Would you approve this as-is, or prefer a cap (e.g., 10% discount instead)?

Thanks for the clear summary. Im comfortable approving a customer-facing package with a small guardrail. Approve with the following edits: 

1) 3-month credit top-up of $22,000 — APPROVED.
2) Discount: approve a 12% credit on first-year invoice (applied as invoice credit), instead of the requested 15% (keeps ARR impact within bounds).
3) Condition the discount on: a signed 12-month MOU, minimum commit = $300k ARR, and standard mutual SLO language (no special residency beyond what's already agreed).
4) Cap the total financial concession (credits + discount) at $70k net present value to protect upside.

Please update the MOU to reflect the credit as an invoice line item and include a one-sentence business justification for audit trail. After Ben sends the revised MOU to Tara, copy procurement@medsight.com and CC legal@redwood.com so we get parallel review.

Vivek
